Title: Hello Tempayy Achari Tadka Protein Paratha
Description: Loaded with protein, these Achari Tadka stuffed parathas bring together chunky tempeh, potatoes and whole spices. They’re comforting, juicy and bursting with flavour in every bite.
Ingredients: Water, Atta (Wheat Atta, Defatted Soya Flour, Peanut Flour), Tempeh, Soya Isolate, Potato, Chickpeas, Mustard Oil, Onion, Tomato, Rice Bran Oil, Ginger Garlic Paste, Pickle, Garlic, Green Chilli, Red Chilli Powder, Kalonji Seeds, Amchoor Powder, Salt, Ginger, Chat Masala, Coriander Powder
